title: FuzzyDiary: An open-source framework for morphology-aware and traceable linguistic summarization of clinical time series
description: FuzzyDiary is an open-source Python framework for protoform-based, morphology-aware linguistic summarization of univariate time series. It couples Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplification with a configurable catalogue of morphological events and fuzzy protoform evaluation, driven by a single YAML configuration, and produces a self-contained interactive HTML report in which every generated statement is linked to the segment of the signal that supports it. The framework is domain-independent; clinical monitoring is its motivating application.
